title: Sun sign vs Moon sign
caption:
sun sign vs moon sign: what's the difference? 🌙
The sun is who you are in daylight. The moon is who you are at home.
cta:
send this to someone who only knows their sun sign 👀
your full chart is free on align, link in bio

ask: Ten seconds, and you'll read your chart better.
explainB: What you need to feel safe.
diff: The sun is who you are in *daylight.*
The moon is who you are at *home.*
